scene sarabarpostyuki1
: Hah...poor Yuki. She’s still so young. I can’t even imagine dealing with something that serious at her age.

scene sarabarpostyuki8
: Honestly, I don’t think I really needed to say anything in the first place...I think us doing things like this is just sort of...expected, in a sense...
: For me, maybe. But for my teenage daughter? I don’t think so.
: Well, forgive me for keeping myself occupied while you were upstairs probably crying. And if it makes you feel any better, I was the one who started it.
: Of course you were. That does not surprise me at all given what I have learned about you lately. Also, I’ll have you know I only cried a little. And that’s just because I love Yuki.
scene sarabarpostyuki9
: I know you do...which is why I’m glad she’s coming back. Having her around should probably help cut back on the stress, right? Can we even afford to pay her, though?
: I commanded her to work for free to make up for all of the absences.
: I don’t think that’s legal.
scene sarabarpostyuki10
: Since when do you care about the law?!
: I never said I objected. Just...making an observation. It only makes sense you’d take advantage of someone else’s labor when you’ve shown me firsthand how little you care about labor laws.
scene sarabarpostyuki11
: Just be happy I’m not making you work at a porn shop like Maki’s daughter is. I can only imagine what that would do for this...sexual awakening of yours.
: Nothing the Internet hasn’t already done, probably.
: Sana, what am I even supposed to say to that?
: I don’t know. You’re the one who brought up sexual awakenings and porn. I’m just trying to have a conversation with my mom here.
scene sarabarpostyuki12
: Oh, good. Then why don’t you tell me about your day at school instead?
: Sure. I got really turned on during gym class and had to go to the bathroom to touch myself.
scene sarabarpostyuki13
: That’s not what I meant!
: Hey, you asked. How was your day then?
: Fine, thank you! See how easy that was?!
: Easy, sure. But that doesn’t mean it’s exciting.
scene sarabarpostyuki14
: Not everything has to be exciting, Sana. In fact, a huge part of growing up and understanding these changes you’re going through is learning how to suppress or control them.
: The whole world would be one giant, lawless orgy if everyone just submitted to their first sign of arousal. Is that really the world you want to-
scene sarabarpostyuki15
: Are you going to finish your question?
: No, because I already know how you’d answer and it would only make me sad.
: I think I get what you’re saying. Like, even Sensei didn’t really want to do anything with me today. He just wanted to sit there and talk.
: Because not everything revolves around sex. Sometimes, people just want to be together. Like me and you. Or...me and Yuki.
: We didn’t have sex when we were upstairs talking. It didn’t even occur to us.
: But you would totally have sex with Yuki if she was gay.
scene sarabarpostyuki16
: Not immediately after finding out she has cancer! There’s a time and a place for that stuff, and if all you do every time you’re feeling it is act on it, it’ll stop being enjoyable at all.
: When? Because that’s what Sensei’s been doing his whole life and he still seems to be enjoying it a lot.
scene sarabarpostyuki17
: That’s because Sensei is a boy and boys are broken. The end.
: That just sounds like a convenient excuse to try and teach me a lesson while giving him the benefit of the doubt.
: Well, that’s probably because it is. Now, tell me how your day at school went without any details about masturbation, please.
: I brought up the threesome to Sensei while you guys were upstairs.
: That doesn’t sound like school at all. Also, what threesome?
: The one with you and me. That we talked about at the bathhouse?
scene sarabarpostyuki18
: You brought that up to him?! Sana!
: That’s why he got so hard that he had to look away from you guys. He was probably thinking about us touching each other.
scene sarabarpostyuki19
: Oh my God.
scene sarabarpostyuki20
: I think I need to go lie down.
: Where are you going? Things were just getting good.
scene sarabarpostyuki21
: We clearly have different definitions of “good” then, because mine does not involve having sex with my daughter.
: But it could if you stopped making such a big deal out of this. Just give it a try. The worst that could happen is you don’t like it and we don’t do it again.
: No, the worst that could happen is that it scars you for life and ruins our relationship forever. And that’s something I refuse to jeopardize, Sana. I can’t lose you too.
scene sarabarpostyuki22
: I thought I already mentioned this will bring us closer together, though.
: You’ve mentioned a lot of things and I remember virtually none of them because this is so insane to me that I’ve been in a perpetual state of shock since watching you get railed on DVD.
: That wasn’t a DVD. It was live.
: Whatever it was! That’s not how I’m supposed to see my little girl!
: I used to give you baths in a sink! I’d do the...what do they call it? The...the airplane thing! When you wouldn’t eat your food! Whoosh! Like that! Now I’m supposed to have a threesome with you?!
: Well, of course it’s weird if you still see me as a baby. But I’m not like that anymore. I’m the same age you were when you were having unprotected sex with your teacher.
: And I think that me wanting to share that with you just shows you how good our relationship is when you never would have done that with Grandma.
: It’s disgusting, Sana.
: You think I’m disgusting?
: What? No, I...hah...
: I don’t think you’re disgusting. I think you’re beautiful. If I thought you were disgusting, I wouldn’t be trying to make this happen in the first place.
scene sarabarpostyuki23
: And Sensei...what did he have to say about this?
: Mostly stuff like, “Sara would never” and “How could you do that to your mom?”
: And you just kept going and asking for it anyway?
: Yeah, because he doesn’t get it. We’re not a normal mother-daughter combination. We’re different from if Makoto and her mom did something like this.
: Why? How? What makes us different? Why can’t we be a normal mother-daughter combination like Maki and her kid?
: I mean...I guess we can. I just figured we love each other a little more than that.
scene sarabarpostyuki24
: What?...
: I mean, I know I love you more than Makoto loves her mom. More than Rin loves hers too.
: I love you more than any of the girls I know love their parents apart from, like...Ami and Sensei. But they’re a whole other story.
: I just don’t understand how any of this leads to experiencing sex together, though. You’ve always tried to keep me out of your life. You don’t even like when I hang out with you and Ayane.
: So how did any of that lead to this? How is this the thing you think will-
scene sarabarpostyuki25
: It’s your job to provide for me, is it not?

: It is...And I know I haven’t provided enough. But I’ve been trying, Sana. I’ve been trying forever. And going through with this isn’t going to provide anything long-term. It’s just...a fantasy. That’s it.
: That’s just pessimism.
: I think this is the first step to starting over. And I think that if either of us are ever going to end up with him, this is something that needs to happen.
: But more than that, it’s something I want to happen. And I want it because I love you and I want to share that love with you.
: It’s not weird at all and you know it. You’re only saying that because you think you’re supposed to say that. Because you think not doing things like this makes you a good mom.
scene sarabarpostyuki26
: But deep down, you know you want it too.
: You know there’s something in our blood that makes us this way. A voice in your head, maybe. A whisper, telling you to do it. Do it. Do it. Driving you crazy if you don’t.
: Maybe that’s just me, though. And maybe I am crazy for believing in the truths I think will lead us to a happy ending.
: Do you think I’m crazy, Mom?
: I don’t think you’re crazy, baby...I just think you have a...strange fetish that you...don’t entirely understand yet.
: So what I’m hearing is you don’t love me.
: Sana...you know that isn’t true. You know that isn’t-
: I do know it isn’t true. It’s what I’m hearing, though. So what I don’t get is why you keep forcing yourself to say things neither one of us believes.
: Wouldn’t it be so much easier to just shut me up by going through with it? Even if it’s just once?
: Because, if it’s as bad as you’re making it sound like it’ll be, maybe I’ll finally see things your way afterward and won’t ever ask you to do it again?
: Or...maybe we’ll both like it. And then all three of us can be together as the family we’re meant to be. I know that’d make me happy, Mom. But how about you?
: I’m just...not entirely...comfortable with this, Sana. I don’t...know if I can...do those things with you. Like...even if I did want to, I...I wouldn’t be able to follow through with it.
: It’s a little weird for me too, you know. You are my mom, after all.
: But...maybe there’s something we can do to sort of...prepare for it?
: Prepare? You mean, like...
scene sarabarpostyuki27
: Like...practice.
: Uhh..........what? P........Practice?...
: Yeah. If it’ll help us get a little more comfortable with the whole idea of it, maybe we should try, like...kissing or something?
